title: BCCDC-PHL/gx-threshold pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

platform.errorMessage: platform must be one of: illumina, nanopore

sample_type.errorMessage: sample_type must be one of: isolate, metagenomic, amplicon_16s, amplicon_other

expected_species.errorMessage: expected_species should be a species name (e.g. 'Escherichia coli') or an NCBI species taxid

reference.errorMessage: reference should be an NCBI assembly accession (GCF_/GCA_...) or a path to a FASTA file, with no spaces

genome_size.errorMessage: genome_size should be a positive integer (bp)
